name: One Tea Scheme
benefit:
1. Ensures fair and stable prices for tea farmers.
1. Prevents distress sales due to low factory rates.
1. Provides direct financial support via DBT.
1. Farmers receive ₹35/kg and ₹40/kg support price.
1. Government pays the difference if factory rate is <semi_colon ₹35/kg and <semi_colon ₹40/kg. 
1. Supports up to 10,000 kgs per farmer.
1. Encourages organic cultivation, using ₹40/kg as ref
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be 18 years of age or above. 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Meghalaya. 1. The applicant should be a tea farmer. 1. The applicant should possess a valid government-issued identity document.
